items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: So, when they did come here, and I got to meet him and the whole group

ctx.x: Well, I'm going to say this briefly. Well, this young fellow is a poet and he's a director and he's -- well, he's into music. He played guitar at one time. And his name is Emilio Bele de Cavajo, and he is quite busy, from South America. He's in Rio de Janeiro. And he was here with a show. Let me see, that's been about four years ago, I guess. They were appearing at Madison Square Garden in New York, then they came here to UCLA, and he called me from New York. He wanted to know if I was going to be in Los Angeles…

So, when they did come here, and I got to meet him and the whole group, and he was the only one in the whole group that spoke English. I couldn't even understand the rest of them, but somehow they understood my music. And they told me that, some of them said they learned some of the English language through my records. I don't know how.
